subject: Site Engineer, Civil Utilities, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Site Engineer, Civil Utilities role in Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. The ad describes an engineer building capability alongside experienced teams on water, sewer and utilities packages.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day with inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works, tracking procurement and materials and keeping site, material and progress reports. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, covering road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design to Australian Standards, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

I have no water or sewer experience yet and I haven't used InEight, Aconex or Procore, so those would be new. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for site work, and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Glad to talk any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

notes:
Large national contractor; early-career site engineer wording on a major SA water and sewer project. The "What you'll bring" list (utilities experience, InEight/Aconex/Procore) carries no essential marker, so those are disclosed as gaps rather than treated as a hold. Interstate: Adelaide relocation is Marc's call. Contact research (29 Sep 2026): the careers board shows the advert first posted 29 June 2026 and valid to 28 December 2026, so it is a long-running or re-posted vacancy; the project is not named by the employer anywhere (do not guess it in an interview). The leadership page names Mehdi Javanmard (EGM Civil and Infrastructure) and Michael Hyde (EGM Engineering and Projects) without emails; no published contact, portal only.
Checked 2026-09-29. The advert's company domain is mcmservices.com.au (mcmahonservices.com.au was tried first and failed at the proxy with a 502; nothing was read from it). Employer identity confirmed: careers.mcmservices.com.au/jobs/search lists 'Site Engineer - Civil Utilities, Adelaide, SA, Australia' together with 'Site Supervisors - Civil Utilities', 'Night Shift Site Supervisor - Civil Utilities' and 'Leading Hands - Civil Utilities' (all Adelaide) and the advert page text matches the SEEK content_text word for word. PROJECT: not named. Neither the advert, the job board, nor any McMahon Services site page or news item read or surfaced by search names the water/sewer project; the advert only says 'one of South Australia's largest and most significant infrastructure projects' / 'the Southern Hemisphere's largest infrastructure project' / 'helping shape Adelaide's future'. Search for that phrase returned government and press pages about the $15.4b River Torrens to Darlington (North-South Corridor) project as SA's largest-ever infrastructure project, and a separate search shows the Osborne Submarine Construction Yard ($30b+, ANI) as the other very large Adelaide project; the employer's own site has an Osborne Naval Shipyard Building 02 project page (ANI client) but nothing tying McMahon Services to the current civil utilities packages of either project. This is unverified speculation only and must not be stated in any application. SA Water's 2026 $1.5b water/sewer framework partners (Fulton Hogan Utilities; John Holland/Guidera O'Connor JV; McConnell Dowell/Diona JV) do not include McMahon Services. CONTACTS: the Executive Team page https://mcmservices.com.au/about/leadership/ (rendered with the headless browser; curl gives a JS shell but the embedded JSON was also parsed) lists 12 executives; every profile's 'email' and 'phone' JSON fields are empty and the page has no mailto or '@' anywhere. Relevant SA-based roles with no published email: Mehdi Javanmard (EGM - Civil & Infrastructure), Michael Hyde (EGM - Engineering & Projects), David Sims (CEO), David McMahon (MD), Andrew McMahon (Director). No project director or construction manager for the utilities project is named anywhere on the employer's site or board. Search results for '@mcmservices.com.au' returned only ZoomInfo, Adapt.io and Datanyze broker pages, which were not opened or used per config; a search-summary mention of a careers@ inbox came from those broker-derived results, was not seen on any employer page, and is therefore not recorded. The corporate Contact page https://mcmservices.com.au/contact/ loads its office details through a WP Store Locator admin-ajax call after a region is selected; the rendered page shows only the region picker and a general 'Submit an Enquiry' web form, so no office email or phone could be read within the fetch budget, and published_generic_contacts is empty rather than guessed. The Osborne Building 02 project page was read in full (employer_line source); the Adelaide Festival Centre Drive project URL from search redirected to the /projects/ index and was not readable. Not readable: SEEK advert page (403 by instruction), mcmahonservices.com.au (proxy 502), contact-page office data (AJAX), Festival Centre project page (redirect). Budget used: 8 of 8 WebSearch; 12 of 12 fetches (curl x9 incl. one failed and one redirect, browse.py x3).

subject: Engineer / Technical Officer, Road Design (East), reference 12067, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Dear Vincent,

I'm preparing an application for the Engineer / Technical Officer, Road Design (East) position (reference 12067) and have two questions before I submit, since the advert names you for further information.

The position description gives Sunshine or Ringwood as the usual place of work. Is the East team based at Ringwood, or would Sunshine be an option? And would a candidate trained on AutoCAD and Civil 3D, who has not used MicroStation or OpenRoads yet, be considered for the VPS 3 role?

For context: an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design finished in February 2026 (road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage to Australian Standards and Austroads guides), a civil engineering degree (Philippines, 2019), and eleven months on site. I'm based in Melton. My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
